title: A Charge-Coupled Area Image Sensor and Frame Store
version: IEEE Transactions on Electron Devices 20(3), pp. 244–252
lineage: An author’s Berkeley-hosted copy of the original IEEE article.

passages.note: The team cites the proposed frame-transfer principle from the 1971 experimental results paper. It describes a small 8-by-15 area experiment separately, and a working 128-by-106 three-phase prototype with separate storage and a serial readout register.

The article shows images from 64-by-106 cells in frame-transfer mode at 120 frames/s and from all 128-by-106 elements at lower frame rates. The optical signal was amplified, filtered and displayed on a monitor.
The authors describe their experimental three-sensor color video camera. Reference 2 identifies the November 1971 line-imaging paper cited for the frame-transfer principle.
